title: Global Humanitarian Vulnerability Indices
text: globalvuln R data package containing country-level data published global vulnerability, fragility, development, hunger, health, gender, debt, safeguarding, displacement indices. Publisher scores remain original scales. package standardises rank decile direction, rank 1 decile 1 always mean vulnerable within countries scored index. Interactive explorer: Compare structure, coverage, concepts, sources 16 indices.

title: Collated country-level humanitarian indices — humanitarian_indices_country
text: *_score, *_rank, *_decile fields occur 16 index_id values documented individual_indices. Debt distress classification therefore ranked placed deciles. Disaster Displacement Risk Model columns retained contain missing values publisher provide stable downloadable country table data snapshot date. rank fields use 1 vulnerable scored observation minimum rank ties. decile fields use 1 vulnerable decile 10 least vulnerable decile. Deciles calculated min(10, floor(10 * (rank - 1) / n_scored) + 1). Consequently, tied scores can make decile contain exactly 10 percent scored countries. scores imputed cross-index meta-score produced.

title: Country-index humanitarian vulnerability data — humanitarian_indices_long
text: complete long-form audit table behind humanitarian_indices_country. Every country-index combination retained, including combinations outside publisher's coverage.

title: Country-index humanitarian vulnerability data — humanitarian_indices_long
text: data frame 3,120 rows 19 variables: country Country name master geography. iso3 Three-letter ISO 3166-1 country code. region United Nations M49 region. subregion United Nations M49 subregion. index_id Stable short identifier index. index_name Human-readable name index. source_country Country label publisher's source; missing country present source. score Publisher score original scale. score_label Publisher display label meaningful, including censored values, score ranges, percentages, classifications. reference_year Year period represented observation. edition Publisher's edition release label. score_direction Whether higher lower publisher score denotes greater vulnerability: higher_worse lower_worse. rankable Whether index eligible ranking. eligible_for_counts Whether rank decile contribute country-level summary counts. n_scored Number countries exact numeric score index. rank Rank among scored countries, 1 denoting vulnerable; ties receive minimum rank. decile Vulnerability decile derived rank, 1 (vulnerable) 10 (least vulnerable). top_10 Whether observation vulnerability decile 1. top_20 Whether observation vulnerability decile 1 2.
